meanings.english: If you strike someone, the act of striking rests on your own hands — you bear the consequence of violence.
If you curse or abuse another, those very words return to burden your own hands — your speech defines you.

meanings.kannada: ಹಿಂದಣ ಜನನವೇನಾದೊಡಾಗಲಿ, ಇಂದಿನ ಭೋಗವು ಕೈಯ ಮೇಲೆ
meanings.transliteration: Hindaṇa jananavēnadoḍāgali, indina bhōgavu kaiya mēle
meanings.english: Whatever your past birth may have been, the fruits of your present deeds and experiences are entirely in your hands today.

meanings.kannada: ಕೂಡಲಸಂಗಮದೇವಯ್ಯಾ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಪೂಜಿಸಿದ ಫಲ ಕೈಯ ಮೇಲೆ
meanings.transliteration: Kūḍala saṅgamadēvayyā, nimma pūjisida phala kaiya mēle
meanings.english: O Lord Kudala Sangama, the reward of worshipping you and living righteously is immediate — it is right here, in our own hands.

contextCards.text: Personal accountability — every action, word, and deed creates its own immediate result in this very life.
Basavanna rejects fatalism. Past births do not bind us — righteous living brings its own fruit, here and now.

vachanaLines: ಅಯ್ಯಾ, ನೀನು ನಿರಾಕಾರವಾಗಿರ್ದಲ್ಲಿ, ನಾನು ಜ್ಞಾನವೆಂಬ ವಾಹನವಾಗಿರ್ದೆ, ಕಾಣಾ.
ಅಯ್ಯಾ, ನೀನು ನಾಟ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ನಿಂದಲ್ಲಿ, ನಾನು ಚೈತನ್ಯವೆಂಬ ವಾಹನವಾಗಿರ್ದೆ, ಕಾಣಾ.
ಅಯ್ಯಾ, ನೀನು ಆಕಾರವಾಗಿರ್ದಲ್ಲಿ, ನಾನು ವೃಷಭನೆಂಬ ವಾಹನವಾಗಿರ್ದೆ, ಕಾಣಾ.
ಅಯ್ಯಾ, ನೀನೆನ್ನ ಭವವ ಕೊಂದಹೆನೆಂದು ಜಂಗಮಲಾಂಛನನಾಗಿ ಬಂದಲ್ಲಿ,
ನಾನು ಭಕ್ತನೆಂಬ ವಾಹನವಾಗಿರ್ದೆ, ಕಾಣಾ, ಕೂಡಲ ಸಂಗಮದೇವಾ.

meanings.kannada: ಅಯ್ಯಾ, ನೀನು ನಿರಾಕಾರವಾಗಿರ್ದಲ್ಲಿ, ನಾನು ಜ್ಞಾನವೆಂಬ ವಾಹನವಾಗಿರ್ದೆ, ಕಾಣಾ.
meanings.transliteration: Ayyā, nīnu nirākāravāgirdalli, nānu jñānavenba vāhanavāgirdē, kāṇā.
meanings.english: O Lord, when You were formless, I became the vehicle called knowledge—behold.

meanings.kannada: ಅಯ್ಯಾ, ನೀನು ನಾಟ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ನಿಂದಲ್ಲಿ, ನಾನು ಚೈತನ್ಯವೆಂಬ ವಾಹನವಾಗಿರ್ದೆ, ಕಾಣಾ.
meanings.transliteration: Ayyā, nīnu nāṭyakke nindalli, nānu chaitanyavenba vāhanavāgirdē, kāṇā.
meanings.english: O Lord, when You stood to dance, I became the vehicle called consciousness—behold.

meanings.kannada: ಅಯ್ಯಾ, ನೀನು ಆಕಾರವಾಗಿರ್ದಲ್ಲಿ, ನಾನು ವೃಷಭನೆಂಬ ವಾಹನವಾಗಿರ್ದೆ, ಕಾಣಾ.
meanings.transliteration: Ayyā, nīnu ākāravāgirdalli, nānu vṛṣabhanemba vāhanavāgirdē, kāṇā.
meanings.english: O Lord, when You took form, I became the vehicle called the bull—behold.

meanings.kannada: ಅಯ್ಯಾ, ನೀನೆನ್ನ ಭವವ ಕೊಂದಹೆನೆಂದು ಜಂಗಮಲಾಂಛನನಾಗಿ ಬಂದಲ್ಲಿ,
meanings.transliteration: Ayyā, nīnenna bhavava kondahenendu jaṅgama-lānchananāgi bandalli,
meanings.english: O Lord, when You came as the Jangama to destroy my worldly existence,

meanings.kannada: ನಾನು ಭಕ್ತನೆಂಬ ವಾಹನವಾಗಿರ್ದೆ, ಕಾಣಾ, ಕೂಡಲ ಸಂಗಮದೇವಾ.
meanings.transliteration: Nānu bhaktanemba vāhanavāgirdē, kāṇā, Kūḍala Saṅgamadēvā.
meanings.english: I became the vehicle called devotion—see this, O Kudala Sangama Deva.

contextCards.text: The devotee aligns with the Divine in every form—knowledge, consciousness, form, and devotion—becoming an instrument (vehicle) of the Divine will.
Spiritual evolution is shown as a progression: from knowledge to awareness to devotion, culminating in surrender to the Divine presence.

meanings.english: It was like a hidden fire of desire submerged within water.
It was like the subtle taste of sap within a plant.
It was like the fragrance hidden within thought, O Kudala Sangama Deva.
It was like the pure love of a maiden.

contextCards.text: The Divine presence is subtle and hidden, like fire in water or fragrance in thought—felt inwardly rather than seen outwardly.
True spiritual experience is pure, intimate, and delicate—comparable to innocent love and inner essence.

meanings.english: Maya became the mother and gave birth to creation.
Maya was born again as the daughter of attachment (delusion).
Maya joined as a woman in worldly relationships and gatherings.
In how many ways has this Maya troubled and entangled us!
To overcome and remove this Maya is not within my capacity.
Only you know the way, O Kudala Sangama Deva.

contextCards.text: Maya (illusion) manifests in many forms—creation, attachment, and relationships—constantly binding the soul to worldly life.
True liberation from illusion is not achieved by individual effort alone, but through surrender to the Divine.

meanings.english: He showed righteous conduct through the body.
He taught that such conduct itself is the Linga (divine principle).
He established awareness within the life-breath.
He showed that this awareness itself is the Jangama (living divinity).
O Chennamallikarjuna,
My nurturing father, Sangana Basavanna,
Has revealed this spiritual path to me.

contextCards.text: True spirituality is not external ritual but lived conduct (achara) and inner awareness—these themselves become the Linga and Jangama.
The Guru plays a vital role in revealing the inner path, guiding the seeker from outward practice to inner realization of the Divine.

vachanaLines: ಅಂಗದ ಭಂಗವ ಲಿಂಗಮುಖದಿಂದ ಗೆಲಿದೆ. ಮನದ ಭಂಗವ ಅರುಹಿನ ಮುಖದಿಂದ ಗೆಲಿದೆ.
ಜೀವದ ಭಂಗವ ಶಿವಾನುಭಾವದಿಂದ ಗೆಲಿದೆ. ಕರಣದ ಕತ್ತಲೆಯ ಬೆಳಗನುಟ್ಟು ಗೆಲಿದೆ.
ಕಾಮನ ಕೊಂದು ಮನಸಿಜನಾಗುಳುಹಿದಡೆ, ಮನಸಿಜನ ತಲೆಯ ಬರಹವ ತೊಡೆದೆನು.

meanings.kannada: ಅಂಗದ ಭಂಗವ ಲಿಂಗಮುಖದಿಂದ ಗೆಲಿದೆ. ಮನದ ಭಂಗವ ಅರುಹಿನ ಮುಖದಿಂದ ಗೆಲಿದೆ.
meanings.transliteration: Aṅgada bhaṅgava liṅgamukhadinda gelide. Manada bhaṅgava aruhina mukhadinda gelide.
meanings.english: The disturbances of the body were overcome through the vision of the Linga; the disturbances of the mind were overcome through true understanding.

meanings.kannada: ಜೀವದ ಭಂಗವ ಶಿವಾನುಭಾವದಿಂದ ಗೆಲಿದೆ. ಕರಣದ ಕತ್ತಲೆಯ ಬೆಳಗನುಟ್ಟು ಗೆಲಿದೆ.
meanings.transliteration: Jīvda bhaṅgava śivānubhāvadinda gelide. Karaṇada kattaleya beḷaganuṭṭu gelide.
meanings.english: The unrest of the soul was overcome through the experience of Shiva; the darkness of the senses was dispelled by the light of awareness.
In the outward glitter of youth that appears to your eyes,
See instead the ash of desire that has been burnt away, O Chennamallikarjuna.

meanings.kannada: ಕಾಮನ ಕೊಂದು ಮನಸಿಜನಾಗುಳುಹಿದಡೆ, ಮನಸಿಜನ ತಲೆಯ ಬರಹವ ತೊಡೆದೆನು.
meanings.transliteration: Kāmana kondu manasijanāguḷuhidade, manasijana taleya barahava toḍedenu.
meanings.english: Having slain desire and become pure in mind, I have erased the fate written upon the head of the mind-born self.

contextCards.text: Spiritual transformation is achieved by overcoming the disturbances of body, mind, and senses through awareness and direct experience of the Divine.
Burning away desire reveals inner purity, freeing one from illusion and rewriting one’s destiny through spiritual realization.

vachanaLines: ಅಂದೂ ನೀನೆ, ಇಂದೂ ನೀನೆ, ಎಂದೂ ನೀನೆ, ಕೇಳಾ ತಂದೆ.
ಅಂದೂ ಇಂದೂ ಎಂದೂ ನಿನ್ನ ನಂಬಿದ ಒಲವಿನ ಶಿಶು ನಾನಯ್ಯ.

meanings.kannada: ಅಂದೂ ನೀನೆ, ಇಂದೂ ನೀನೆ, ಎಂದೂ ನೀನೆ, ಕೇಳಾ ತಂದೆ.
meanings.transliteration: andū nīne, indū nīne, endū nīne, kēḷā tande.
meanings.english: You were there then, You are here now, and You will always be, O beloved Father.
I am the ancient daughter who has always remained under Your protection.

meanings.kannada: ಅಂದೂ ಇಂದೂ ಎಂದೂ ನಿನ್ನ ನಂಬಿದ ಒಲವಿನ ಶಿಶು ನಾನಯ್ಯ.
meanings.transliteration: andū indū endū ninna nambida olavina śiśu nānayya.
meanings.english: Then, now, and forever, I am the child of love who trusts only in You.
I know no duality other than the One.
Listen to me, my Father, O Chennamallikarjuna,
I am the devoted old servant sustained by Your grace and remnants.

contextCards.text: This vachana expresses unwavering devotion and complete surrender to the Divine across all time—past, present, and future.
Akka Mahadevi emphasizes non-duality, declaring that the soul recognizes only the One Divine presence and no separation from it.

vachanaLines: ಹಸಿವು, ತೃಷೆ, ನಿದ್ರೆ, ವಿಷಯಂಗಳ ಮರೆದೆ, ನೀವು ಕಾರಣ !
ಕಾಮ, ಕ್ರೋಧ, ಲೋಭ, ಮೋಹ, ಮದ, ಮತ್ಸರಂಗಳ ಮರೆದೆ, ನೀವು ಕಾರಣ !
ಪಂಚೇಂದ್ರಿಯ, ಸಪ್ತಧಾತು, ಅಷ್ಟಮದಂಗಳ ಮರೆದೆ. ನೀವು ಕಾರಣ !

meanings.kannada: ಹಸಿವು, ತೃಷೆ, ನಿದ್ರೆ, ವಿಷಯಂಗಳ ಮರೆದೆ, ನೀವು ಕಾರಣ !
meanings.transliteration: hasivu, tṛṣe, nidre, viṣayangaḷa marede, nīvu kāraṇa!
meanings.english: I forgot hunger, thirst, sleep, and worldly pleasures — You are the reason!

meanings.kannada: ಕಾಮ, ಕ್ರೋಧ, ಲೋಭ, ಮೋಹ, ಮದ, ಮತ್ಸರಂಗಳ ಮರೆದೆ, ನೀವು ಕಾರಣ !
meanings.transliteration: kāma, krōdha, lōbha, mōha, mada, matsarangaḷa marede, nīvu kāraṇa!
meanings.english: I forgot desire, anger, greed, attachment, pride, and jealousy — You are the reason!

meanings.kannada: ಪಂಚೇಂದ್ರಿಯ, ಸಪ್ತಧಾತು, ಅಷ್ಟಮದಂಗಳ ಮರೆದೆ. ನೀವು ಕಾರಣ !
meanings.transliteration: pañcēndriya, saptadhātu, aṣṭamadangaḷa marede. nīvu kāraṇa!
meanings.english: I transcended the five senses, the seven bodily elements, and the eight forms of ego — You are the reason!
O Kudalasangama Deva,
When Your devotees are cared for and nourished,
I feel fulfilled and completely satisfied.

contextCards.text: Basavanna expresses that divine devotion can elevate a person beyond physical needs, emotional weaknesses, and worldly attachments.
The vachana teaches that true fulfillment comes not from personal gain, but from serving and caring for the devotees of the Divine.

meanings.english: Like fire hidden within stone,
Like a reflection existing within water,
Like a tree concealed within a seed,
Like silence hidden within sound,
O Guheshwara, such is the bond between You and Your devotees.

contextCards.text: Allama Prabhu describes the divine relationship as subtle and hidden, present within all existence just as fire resides unseen within stone.
The vachana teaches that true spiritual connection is inward and profound, discovered through silence, devotion, and inner realization rather than outward appearance.

meanings.english: Having forgotten bodily distortions and worldly attachments,
Show me those who remain united with the Linga.
Having removed the darkness created by lust and desire,
Show me those whose very life-breath is devotion.
Those who are pure in thought, word, and deed, and who trust completely in You,
O Chennamallikarjuna, show me such true devotees.

contextCards.text: Akka Mahadevi prays for the company of spiritually awakened devotees who have transcended bodily desires and remain united with the Divine.
The vachana emphasizes purity of thought, speech, and action, teaching that true devotion arises when one removes ego, lust, and worldly attachment.
